record.name: Corrected k-mer / position baseline on MFASS v2

attributes.protocol: Assay-oriented 21 bp k-mer window, exon position, allele identity and conservation features; gradient-boosted trees trained on the MFASS training split.

paired_comparison.note: Refer to paired bootstrap artifacts; marginal scores are not paired comparisons.

reproduction.explanation: This mapping supports rescoring the original held-out prediction IDs under the corrected MFASS v2 protocol. It does not regenerate model predictions or establish reproduction of the published score. Preserve the reported missing-prediction coverage.
reproduction.source_locator: docs/mfass.md: archived predictions; protocols/mfass.py: canonical split, score and coverage
